commands: upload_logs() { status=$1; echo step=upload-remote-install-node-${NODE_ID} status=$status; aws s3 cp "$LOG_DIR" "s3://$BUCKET/$S3_PREFIX/deploy-fix/remote-${NODE_ID}-install" --recursive --region us-west-2 || true; }
sudo -u postgres psql -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -U ecaz_coord -d postgres -At -c "SELECT extversion FROM pg_extension WHERE extname='ecaz';" > "$LOG_DIR/extension-version-after.log"

sudo -u postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -U ecaz_coord -d postgres -A -t -c "SELECT jsonb_build_object('remote_index_regclass', '${REMOTE_INDEX}', 'last_served_epoch', a.active_epoch, 'min_retained_epoch', a.active_epoch, 'extension_version', e.extension_version, 'remote_index_identity_hex', e.profile_fingerprint, 'endpoint_status', e.status, 'tuple_transport_status', e.tuple_transport_status)::text FROM ec_spire_remote_search_endpoint_identity('${REMOTE_INDEX}'::regclass::oid) e CROSS JOIN ec_spire_index_active_snapshot_diagnostics('${REMOTE_INDEX}'::regclass::oid) a" > "$LOG_DIR/identity.json" 2> "$LOG_DIR/identity.stderr.log"
